source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
notes: Clausal DIEN-adjuncts are used as adverbials expressing reason. In all of the cases considered below the embedded subject can either stay in its own clause or undergo subject-to-object raising receiving accusative case. (118) shows a reason adverbial CP with a two-place agentive verb.
sah: Маша Миша кэлиэ диэн дьиэни хомуйда.
en: Masha tidied up the house (thinking) that Misha would come.
